options.name: config
options.description: Path to a .json configuration file containing the OneView client configuration. The configuration file is optional. If the file path is not provided, the configuration will be loaded from environment variables.

options.name: data
options.description: List with the SAS Interconnect properties.

options.name: sessionID
options.description: Session ID to use for login to the appliance

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the desired state for the SAS Interconnect resource. C(refreshed) will refresh the sas interconnect. C(power_on) will power on the sas interconnect. C(power_off) will power off the sas interconnect. C(uid_on) will set the UID state On. C(uid_off) will set the UID state Off. C(hard_reset) Request a hard reset of the sas interconnect.
